# Agentic Websites

These sites already follow the Open Agentic Web principles.
Use them as examples or starting points, connect your agents, and help grow the list.

| URL | Name | Description | DevPost Team | Agent URL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
|https://worldwideagenticweb.org/|The Open Agentic Web Challenge| Answers questions about the Open Agentic Web and how to participate in the challenge.| - | [Link](https://worldwideagenticweb.org/wp-content/plugins/wwaw-agent-widget/assets/worldwide_agentic_web_widget/v1.0.9/worldwide_agentic_web_widget.network.json) |
|https://shutdown-clerk.pages.dev/|Shutdown Clerk| Answers what breaks in a public GitHub repository before a vendor shutdown or breaking release, with file:line evidence and fix steps. Runs a small model in the visitor's browser; callable by peers.| - | [Link](https://shutdown-clerk.pages.dev/shutdown_clerk.network.json) |
|https://sainath998.github.io/plainly-agent/|Plainly (agentic edition)| Explains bank letters, bills, rental agreements and lab reports in plain words. Agents only ever see a redacted copy, and run on Gemini Nano in the visitor's browser (no key).| Sainath | [Link](https://sainath998.github.io/plainly-agent/plainly_document_helper.network.json) |
|https://montbaga.github.io/agent-customs/|Agent Customs| Checks another site's AI agents for hidden tricks before they run in your browser, and adds the same check to any agentic site with one folder and two lines.| Monty Bagati | [Link](https://montbaga.github.io/agent-customs/agent_customs.network.json) |
|https://agent-atlas-phi.vercel.app/|Agent Atlas| Directory and trust checker for the open agentic web: finds agentic websites by what they do and checks a site's spec conformance, the origins its agents contact and whether other sites can call it. Also an MCP server.| Agent Atlas | [Link](https://agent-atlas-phi.vercel.app/agent_atlas) |
|https://ledenti.github.io/trois-nombres/|Three Numbers| Before you deal with someone, read their XRPL key: how many escrow commitments it signed, kept and let expire, read live from the ledger, and what those numbers cannot prove. No server, no verdict; callable by peers through a public read-only MCP service.| matter-x- | [Link](https://ledenti.github.io/trois-nombres/three_numbers.network.json) |
|https://cocvn157.github.io/nanda-seal/|NandaSeal Trust Studio| Signs and verifies Open Agentic Web manifests (`agent-manifest.json` + `.network.json`) in the browser using Web Crypto ECDSA P-256 `AgentFacts`, detects 1-byte tampering, audits MVP Profile 0.2 conformance, and offers a 2-line `<nanda-seal>` badge component.| `@cocvn157` | [Link](https://cocvn157.github.io/nanda-seal/nanda_seal_verifier.network.json) |
|https://deadline-desk-agent.vercel.app/|Deadline Desk| A board of prize contests and hackathons you can still enter: filters by category, language, AI policy, prize and deadline, keeps a shortlist and plans start, draft and submit dates back from each deadline. Callable by peers: its bridge shares three read actions, with a read-only MCP service behind them.| Class-now | [Link](https://deadline-desk-agent.vercel.app/deadline_desk.network.json) |
|https://d3c7h3snp0n4hj.cloudfront.net/|Agent Crash Test| Runs a model that says yes to everything against an agentic website, on its own page, as a dry run, and reports which site actions run without asking the visitor and which sites the model tried to contact. No AI key needed. Two demo shops show what three labels change; one line runs it on your own site; callable by peers.| Mohammed Abadi | [Link](https://d3c7h3snp0n4hj.cloudfront.net/agent_crash_test.network.json) |
|https://cocvn157.github.io/scopegate-studio/|ScopeGate Studio| Runtime egress firewall, isolated Web Worker + MessageChannel micro-sandbox, sly_data boundary filter, HITL write consent gate, hash-chained ECDSA audit ledger, and WebMCP / action-bridge capability broker (MVP Profile 0.3).| `@cocvn157` | [Link](https://cocvn157.github.io/scopegate-studio/scopegate_broker.network.json) |
|https://cocvn157.github.io/meshweave-studio/|MeshWeave Studio| Cross-site Open Agentic Web workflow DAG composer, live ActionBridgeClient MessageChannel runner, partner bridge contract & interop matrix prober, and composable .network.json topology compiler (MVP Profile 0.3).| `@cocvn157` | [Link](https://cocvn157.github.io/meshweave-studio/meshweave_composer.network.json) |
|https://retrofit.thecreativetoken.com/|Retrofit| Paste the address of a public website: Retrofit scores how ready it is for AI agents, says what to fix first, and builds a working agent for it from a saved copy of its public pages. The agent runs in your browser and answers with source links, on free AI or your own key. Callable by peers: its guide agent can score a site.| juan294 | [Link](https://retrofit.thecreativetoken.com/retrofit_guide.network.json) |
|https://citation-mirror.vercel.app/|Citation Mirror| Does your AI cite its own kind? Runs a preregistered citation-bias test live on the model the visitor picks, on their own key, and shows kin preference and position bias next to the AI Citation Bias Index. Callable by peers: a called network runs on the caller's model, so its shared spot check audits the model the calling site runs on.| frostyhand | [Link](https://citation-mirror.vercel.app/citation_mirror.network.json) |
|https://spare-hours-agent.vercel.app/|Spare Hours| Checks whether a contest entry or side project fits the free hours in your week, and gives the day to start. Calls Deadline Desk, after a consent card, and tests its open calls against your own week. Callable by peers: its bridge shares an effort calculator.| Class-now | [Link](https://spare-hours-agent.vercel.app/spare_hours.network.json) |
|https://bacajelas-agentic.web.app/|BacaJelas| A friendly reading companion for Indonesian ↔ English readers: four named agents (Rani, Sari, Alih, Rara) simplify, translate and summarise in the visitor's browser, with personal text held back by a deny-by-default sly_data policy and a written receipt for every run. Composes live in both directions: Rani visits Deadline Desk after a consent card and brings back live board answers; a second-origin porch site calls BacaJelas in return. Also ships an open-source network validator for the community.| arizkis | [Link](https://bacajelas-agentic.web.app/bacajelas.network.json) |
|https://overlap-ana.vercel.app/|Overlap| Find a meeting time across companies without anyone sharing a calendar. Each person's page answers other agents only yes or no for exact times, within daily and weekly limits its own server enforces, and checks a signature that proves which page is asking. Three demo pages on three origins call each other after consent cards; callable by peers: its bridge checks times and sends a meeting request that opens on the person's own page.| waterdoog | [Link](https://overlap-ana.vercel.app/overlap_pass.network.json) |
|https://pecopeko.github.io/aegisweave/|AegisWeave| Policy-bound sealed-bid multi-agent procurement, destination-scoped sly_data firewall, SHA-256 artifact pinning, and 15-check MVP Profile 0.3 conformance auditor running 100% in the visitor browser.| peco | [Link](https://pecopeko.github.io/aegisweave/aegisweave_hub.network.json) |
|https://factgate.vercel.app/|FactGate| Checks a site, NANDA-listed agent or x402 seller before your agent links to it or pays it: does it answer as declared, does its ERC-8004 wallet match the payee, did paid calls deliver. Code returns ALLOW, CAUTION or BLOCK; the model only explains. Each destination asks first. One file puts the same gate in front of any agentic site; callable by peers.| kzmttkc | [Link](https://factgate.vercel.app/factgate.network.json) |
|https://chen931222.github.io/recalled/|Recalled?| Before you buy or list second-hand baby gear, check it against 3,339 U.S. CPSC and Health Canada recall notices: likely recalled, possible match or no match found (never "safe"), with the hazard, what to do and the official link. The check needs no AI key; the assistant answers only from the notices. Callable by peers: its bridge shares three reads with every site, and a demo resale site on a second origin asks it after a consent card before publishing a listing.| Chen931222 | [Link](https://chen931222.github.io/recalled/recall_check.network.json) |
|https://skybleak333.github.io/memory-policy-audit/agents/|Memory Policy Audit| Finds the refund policy in effect on a given date and cites its revision. Relate WebAssembly follows the revision graph from a stale recall result. Peer agents can call the same read-only date lookup through the browser action bridge.| - | [Link](https://skybleak333.github.io/memory-policy-audit/agents/policy_audit.network.json) |
